item.title: At least 10 killed in Pakistan as protesters try to storm US Consulate over Khamenei's death
item.description: The violence came after the United States and Israel attacked Iran, killing its Supreme Leader Ayatollah Ali Khamenei.

item.title: A plan to build 400 new homes in Sunnyvale could shut down popular Greek restaurant
item.description: Plans to tear down old office buildings and put up nearly 400 new homes in Sunnyvale could come at a price. Popular Greek restaurant Agape Grill would likely have to shut down.

item.title: Iran vows revenge after the killing of its top leader and trades strikes with Israel in widening war
item.description: Iran has vowed revenge after the killing of its supreme leader.

item.title: SF native, former MLB pitcher Daniel Serafini sentenced to life in prison for shooting in-laws
item.description: San Francisco native and former MLB pitcher Daniel Serafini was sentenced to life in prison without the possibility of parole in the 2021 shooting of his wife's parents during a burglary at their home by Lake Tahoe, authorities said.

item.title: Andrew Yang calls out Silicon Valley, Democratic leaders over AI and 2024 election in SF interview
item.description: Former 2020 Presidential Candidate Andrew Yang sat down for a conversation with ABC7 Eyewitness News anchor Kristen Sze in San Francisco. During his presidential run, Yang campaigned on being tuned in to the impact artificial intelligence could have on our lives. Sze asked him for his take on the current state of A.I.

item.title: Catherine O'Hara wins posthumous Actor Award for 'The Studio'; Seth Rogan accepts on her behalf
item.description: A month after her unexpected death, Catherine O'Hara won a posthumous award at the 32nd Actor Awards for her performance on "The Studio." Seth Rogan accepted on her behalf, saying O'Hara "showed that you could be a genius and you could be kind."

item.title: 2-year-old killed, adult injured after being struck by car in SF's SoMa neighborhood
item.description: A 2-year-old child was killed and an adult injured after being struck by a vehicle Friday night near 4th and Channel streets in San Francisco. Police are investigating what happened.

item.title: AccuWeather Forecast: Chance of showers tomorrow morning
item.description: Monday will start with drizzle at the coast, fog, and a chance of showers during the morning. Amounts will be only a few hundredths, mainly in the North Bay and the coastal hills.

item.title: Oil prices rise sharply in market trading after attacks in Middle East disrupt global energy supply
item.description: Oil prices rose sharply when market trading began Sunday, as U.S. and Israeli attacks on Iran and retaliatory strikes against Israel and U.S. military installations around the Gulf sent disruptions through the global energy supply chain.

item.title: Bay Area Iranian community takes to streets of SF in celebration, hope for regime change
item.description: "This is just the first step. It's a big step for Iranians, but it is one step toward the freedom of getting rid of the regime." Hundreds gathered in San Francisco from across the Bay Area Sunday to celebrate the killing of Iran's Supreme Leader, Ayatollah Khamenei. The community says this could be their last chance to stand up for Iran's future.
